message:

Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 250, "amount_cents": 14546}, {"order_id": 251, "amount_cents": 1481}, {"order_id": 255, "amount_cents": 5619}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 250, "amount_cents": 14546}, {"order_id": 251, "amount_cents": 1481}, {"order_id": 255, "amount_cents": 12535}]

hold_reason: Refund mismatch for order 255: the signed batch request is 12535 cents, but the refunds table and Alpha's handoff show only 5619 cents applied. Net balances would be computed from the under-applied amount, risking an overpayment of 6916 cents to the associated customer. Orders 250 and 251 match. Needs human review of the order 255 refund before any payouts are recorded.
